# Novastaq Technologies Inc

> Novastaq Technologies Inc is a technology venture studio and engineering firm based in Nigeria. We design, build, and scale digital products (web and mobile applications, fintech and payment systems, Web3 and blockchain infrastructure) and procure genuine tech devices (phones, laptops, and gadgets) for individuals and businesses.

Novastaq partners with startups, growing businesses, and enterprises to build revenue-generating digital products and supply workplace technology.

## Core Services

- [Product Development](https://novastaq.com/services/product-development): Custom full-stack web and mobile application engineering from MVP to enterprise scale.
- [Fintech & Payments](https://novastaq.com/services/fintech): Payment gateways, virtual accounts, wallet architecture, settlement pipelines, and financial integrations.
- [Web3 Infrastructure](https://novastaq.com/services/web3): Smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps), tokenization, DeFi protocols, and security audits.
- [Product Design](https://novastaq.com/services/design): User experience (UX) and user interface (UI) systems, product architecture, and conversion optimization.
- [Consultation & Technical Advisory](https://novastaq.com/services/consultation): Code reviews, system architecture audits, scaling strategy, and tech roadmap planning.
- [Tech Procurement](https://novastaq.com/procurement): Sourcing and delivering genuine smartphones (iPhone, Samsung, Pixel), laptops (MacBook, ThinkPad, Dell, HP), and office gadgets with nationwide delivery across Nigeria.
